high_risk_moment: Eligibility and ranking before recruiter review
harm_description: Quy tắc hoặc proxy tuổi và giới có thể chặn cơ hội được con người xem xét
existing_controls: No automatic rejection is intended in product scope
proposed_controls: Remove protected attributes and proxies; approve every eligibility rule; test subgroup recall before release
human_oversight: Recruiter must review every adverse recommendation with evidence and appeal reviewer can restore the application
monitoring_metric: Automatic rejection count and selection-rate ratio by monitored group
trigger_threshold: Any automatic rejection or approved disparity threshold breach
response_action: Pause screening preserve logs notify compliance and manually re-review every potentially affected application

harm_description: Historical selection patterns can reduce ranking through gender-correlated resume features
existing_controls: Human recruiter makes the formal shortlist decision
proposed_controls: Use job analysis; remove protected proxies; evaluate representative holdout sets; publish subgroup results
human_oversight: Recruiter sees evidence rather than a bare score and reviews every near-threshold case plus a random sample
monitoring_metric: Qualified-candidate recall gap and recruiter override rate
trigger_threshold: Recall gap above 5 percentage points in any validated run
response_action: Block release investigate features revise data and require independent re-validation

harm_description: An inaccessible assessment or missing accommodation path can screen out a qualified applicant
proposed_controls: Disclose tool use; provide accessible alternative; test assistive technology; exclude disability-derived signals
human_oversight: Accommodation specialist must respond before deadline and can substitute an equivalent assessment or override the result
monitoring_metric: Accommodation completion rate and accessibility-related exclusion count
trigger_threshold: Any exclusion before an accommodation request is resolved
response_action: Pause affected assessment extend deadlines provide manual alternative and conduct accessibility incident review
